identification: Single wide pale live-edge slab chalked 1114, beside 1113 and 1115 in the same run. Not confirmed. Gowans catalogue routinely labels such slabs Huon pine.

viewing_check: Check whether it is genuinely Huon pine: fine tight grain, golden tint on a fresh scraped surface, and the distinctive sweet resinous smell. Pale plain slab with no smell is likely celery top or other pine. Also note thickness, length and width, and any splits or rot.
